verdict.rationale: Superset's core purpose is running several coding agents at once on one repo, each in its own Git worktree and branch, with a dashboard for monitoring many concurrent sessions. It can also fan out a refactor or migration across worktrees through the orchestrate skill, CLI, SDK and MCP server. A power user independently reports running 40-50 agent sessions across several repos simultaneously without issues. Missing for 10: worktrees do not sandbox processes or prevent merge conflicts between parallel tasks, and there are no documented concurrency limits or throughput benchmarks.
